title: Sweet Potato Risotto
subtitle: with Thyme Mushrooms
description: Roast sweet potato until golden, pan-fry a handful of mushrooms with thyme, then stir into creamy rice for one of the best-tasting vego risottos around town.

steps.text: Prep vegetables: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Brush or wipe the mushrooms clean, then halve or quarter any large ones. Pick the thyme leaves, discarding the stems. Finely chop the onion. Finely grate the cheese.

Roast sweet potato: Peel the sweet potato and cut into 1-2cm chunks (see Kitchen hack). Put on the lined tray, drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and roast for 20 mins or until tender and golden. Meanwhile, crumble the stock cubes into a heatproof jug, add 625ml (2½ cups) boiling water and stir to dissolve.

Cook mushrooms: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms, stirring regularly, for 5 mins or until golden. Add half the thyme and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant. Season with salt, then transfer to a bowl.

Add rice and stock: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the pan over medium heat. Cook the onion, garlic and remaining thyme, stirring, for 3 mins or until softened. Add the rice and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until the grains are well coated. Add the stock, reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 15 mins or until most of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is almost tender.

Serve up: Remove the pan from the heat and stand for 5 mins. Gently stir in the roasted sweet potato and half the mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Divide the risotto among bowls, spoon over the remaining mushrooms, scatter over the cheese, and enjoy.
Kitchen hack: Instead of roasting the sweet potato, make this a one-pot wonder by coarsely grating the sweet potato and adding to the pan with the stock.
